title: 第5章  难道是因为我长得帅？
slug: 我一杂役怎么成掌门孩子他爹了
content_zh:
太玄宗，杂役峰。
叶长天径直来到杂役峰事务处，准备申请晋升为外门弟子。
在太玄宗，杂役弟子晋升外门弟子其实就只有一个条件，只要修为达到炼气三层即可。
可这看似简单的条件，对于绝大多数杂役弟子来说，却是难如登天。
杂役弟子几乎都是一些伪灵根以及杂灵根的废物。
他们存在的目的就是承担宗门诸多杂务琐事，专门为正式弟子服务的。
修行天赋不足，每天都有干不完的活，而且无法享受到宗门的任何福利，又有几个能够修炼到炼气三层晋升外门弟子？
事务处大殿，一群杂役弟子在此有序地排队等候着。
柜台里。
一位杂役峰执事懒洋洋地靠在椅子上，一双色眯眯的眼睛不断地在面前那位女子身上扫视着，目光一片火热：
“小丫头，新来的吧，你叫什么名字？”
叶长天的目光也是落在了那位女子的身上。
女子一身白裙，肌肤如雪，五官精致如画，一双美眸灵动出尘，完全就是一位祸国殃民级别的美人。
即便是与绝色掌门夏秋水相比，恐怕都不会逊色多少。
叶长天看着白裙女子，忍不住一阵惋惜。
多么漂亮的女子，可惜了啊。
现在坐在那里的杂役峰执事叫宋浩，仗着自己父亲是杂役峰长老，一直在杂役峰欺男霸女，无恶不作。
据说这家伙还好色成性。
这位新来的杂役弟子长得如此绝色，又岂能逃过宋浩的魔掌？
“我叫月青霜。”

就在叶长天暗自思索之际，白裙女子开口了，声音显得非常悦耳动听。
白裙女子正是太玄宗曾经的圣女，天月圣女月青霜。
她虽然曾是万众瞩目的圣女，天月圣女之名极为响亮，但却常年带着面纱，整个太玄宗知晓她真容与真名的都屈指可数。
在得到师尊夏秋水的指引后，月青霜第一时间就装成新入宗的杂役弟子，前来寻找师尊口中的叶长天。
“月师妹啊，太玄宗杂役弟子可不是那么好混的。”
宋浩笑眯眯地说道：“我身边正好缺个侍女，不如你以后就留在我身边吧，这样就不用去干杂役弟子的活了。”
“抱歉，我没兴趣做你的侍女。”
月青霜黛眉微微一皱：“麻烦这位师兄快给我登记吧。”
“月青霜，你一个新来的杂役弟子，能够被我看上做我的侍女，你应该感到庆幸，不要给脸不要脸！”
见得月青霜竟然拒绝自己，宋浩脸色也是瞬间阴沉了下来。
他将脑袋凑到月青霜面前，肆无忌惮地打量着月青霜的身体，语气中透露着几分威胁之意：
“你要是识相的话，就最好乖乖听话，敢在杂役峰违逆我宋浩的意思，我有一百种方法让你跪下来求饶。”
月青霜闻言，美眸中顿时闪过一抹冰冷的寒芒。
一个小小的杂役峰执事，竟然也敢如此欺男霸女，横行霸道！
简直该死！
若非考虑到此行的目的，她恐怕早就出手将这家伙宰了。
月青霜强压下心头的怒意，淡淡道：“宋浩师兄，我来太玄宗是为了寻找我师兄叶长天的，你敢这样对我，师兄一定不会放过你的。”
唰！唰！唰！
随着月青霜此话一处，场中不少杂役弟子的目光，都是齐刷刷地朝着叶长天望了过来。
在太玄宗杂役弟子中，叶长天还是非常有名的。

不少太玄宗杂役弟子都知道，叶长天来到太玄宗三年，几乎一直全年无休地干活赚取修炼资源。
最无语的是。
叶长天赚来的修炼资源，自己一点没用，据说全部送给了他那位身在内门的未婚妻。
杂役峰拼命三郎！
杂役峰第一舔狗！
拥有这两大头衔的叶长天，在杂役峰想不出名都难。
他们显然也没想到，眼前这个绝色美女，竟然会是来找叶长天的。
“……”
听得月青霜的话，感受着众人的目光，叶长天一脸懵逼地僵在了原地。
他就看戏吃瓜而已，怎么还吃瓜吃到自己身上了？
长天师兄？
虽然在来太玄宗之前，他也有过一位老师，可那位老师似乎并未收过这样一位漂亮得不像话的师妹啊。
“叶长天，她真是你师妹？”
就在叶长天一脸懵逼的时候，宋浩那不善的目光也是瞬间朝着叶长天望了过来。
叶长天心中暗骂不已。
这特么都什么事啊。
他只是单纯的来申请晋升外门弟子而已，怎么就莫名其妙惹上这样的事情了？
宋浩这家伙行事嚣张霸道，背后还有杂役峰长老撑腰。
那月青霜虽然漂亮，但他也并非那种见到美女就迈不动腿的人。
为一个不相干的女人得罪宋浩？

不值得！
就在叶长天刚要准备澄清的时候，月青霜却是快步朝他跑了过来，一脸惊喜地抱住了他的胳膊。
“长天师兄，我终于找到你了。”
叶长天身体瞬间僵住。
他看着死死抱住自己胳膊的月青霜，脸色黑得跟锅底似的。
“这位小姐，我根本不认识你，你到底想干什么？”
月青霜一副可怜兮兮地道：“长天师兄，那宋浩分明对我不怀好意，你就帮帮我吧，你忍心看着我就这么被宋浩糟蹋么？”
“我也就是个杂役弟子，如何能帮你？”
叶长天一脸无语。
这里一大群杂役弟子，你为何偏偏就找上了我呢。
难道是因为我长得最帅？
“长天师兄，我家里什么都不多，就是灵石多，只要你愿意帮我，我给你一千灵石如何？”
月青霜对着叶长天眨了眨灵动的大眼睛。
在来杂役峰之前，她就了解过叶长天的信息，这家伙每天都在拼命赚取灵石，完全就是个视财如命的主儿。
月青霜也没有废话，直接灵石开道。
叶长天眼眸微微一亮，一脸为难地道：“月师妹，这不是灵石的问题……”
“三千！”
月青霜直接伸出五根纤纤玉指：“只要长天师兄愿意保护我，我给你三千灵石！”
这特么是个小富婆啊。
叶长天顿时双眼放光，生生将到了嘴边的话给吞了回去。

他立马义正言辞地道：“青霜师妹，灵石不灵石这都不重要，重要的是你既然叫我一声师兄，保护你的安全，我叶长天义不容辞！”
content_en:
Taixuanzong, Miscellaneous Peak.
Ye Changtian went straight to the Miscellaneous Peak Affairs Office and prepared to apply for promotion to an outer disciple.
In Taixuan Sect, there is actually only one condition for a handyman disciple to be promoted to an outer disciple, as long as his cultivation reaches the third level of Qi Refining.
But this seemingly simple condition is actually extremely difficult for most of the handyman disciples.
The handyman disciples are almost all wastes with pseudo-spiritual roots and miscellaneous spiritual roots.
The purpose of their existence is to undertake many chores of the sect and to serve the official disciples exclusively.
With insufficient cultivation talent, there is endless work to do every day, and they cannot enjoy any benefits of the sect. How many people can cultivate to the third level of Qi Refining and be promoted to outer sect disciples?
In the main hall of the Affairs Office, a group of handyman disciples were waiting in line in an orderly manner.
at the counter.
A handyman peak deacon leaned lazily on his chair, his squinting eyes constantly scanning the woman in front of him with fiery eyes:
"Little girl, you're new here, what's your name?"
Ye Changtian's eyes also fell on that woman.
The woman is wearing a white dress, her skin is like snow, her facial features are delicate and picturesque, and her beautiful eyes are astonishing. She is a beauty who can bring disaster to the country and the people.
Even compared to the stunning leader Xia Qiushui, I'm afraid she won't be much inferior.
Ye Changtian looked at the woman in the white dress and couldn't help but feel a pity.
What a beautiful woman, what a pity.
The deacon sitting there now is called Song Hao. He has been bullying men and dominating women in the mountain because his father is the elder of the mountain and does all kinds of evil.
It is said that this guy is quite lustful.
This new handyman disciple was so beautiful, how could he escape Song Hao's clutches?
"My name is Yue Qingshuang."
Just as Ye Changtian was thinking secretly, the woman in the white dress spoke, and her voice sounded very pleasant.
The woman in the white dress is none other than the former saint of Taixuan Sect, the Heavenly Moon Saint Yue Qingshuang.
Although she was once a saint that attracted much attention and her name was very resounding, she wore a veil all the year round. Only a handful of people in the entire Taixuan Sect knew her true appearance and name.
After receiving the guidance from Master Xia Qiushui, Yue Qingshuang immediately pretended to be a new disciple of the sect and came to find Ye Changtian mentioned by Master.
"Junior Sister Yue, the handyman disciples of Taixuan Sect are not that easy to get along with."
Song Hao said with a smile: "I happen to be short of a maid. Why don't you stay with me from now on, so that you don't have to do the work of a handyman disciple."
"Sorry, I'm not interested in being your maid."
Yue Qingshuang frowned slightly: "Senior Brother, please register for me quickly."
"Yue Qingshuang, you, a new handyman disciple, can be chosen by me to be my maid, you should feel lucky, don't be shameless!"
Seeing Yue Qingshuang rejecting him, Song Hao's face instantly darkened.
He put his head in front of Yue Qingshuang and looked at Yue Qingshuang's body unscrupulously, with a hint of threat in his tone:
"If you are wise, you'd better be obedient and dare to disobey me, Song Hao, at the Miscellaneous Peak. I have a hundred ways to make you kneel down and beg for mercy."
When Yue Qingshuang heard this, an icy cold light suddenly flashed in her beautiful eyes.
A little handyman named Deacon Feng actually dared to bully men and women and act tyrannically!
Damn it!
If she hadn't considered the purpose of this trip, she might have killed this guy long ago.
Yue Qingshuang suppressed the anger in her heart and said calmly: "Senior Brother Song Hao, I came to Taixuan Sect to find my senior brother Ye Changtian. If you dare to treat me like this, senior brother will definitely not let you go."
Uh-huh! Uh-huh! Uh-huh!
Following Yue Qingshuang's words, many handyman disciples in the field all looked towards Ye Changtian.
Among the handyman disciples of Taixuan Sect, Ye Changtian is still very famous.
Many handyman disciples of Taixuanzong know that Ye Changtian has been in Taixuanzong for almost three years.He has been working around the clock to earn cultivation resources.
The most speechless thing is.
The cultivation resources Ye Changtian earned were of no use to him. It was said that all of them were given to his fiancée who was in the inner sect.
The handyman peak is desperate Saburo!
The number one dog licker in the handyman peak!
Ye Changtian, who holds these two major titles, would find it difficult not to become famous in Zaiya Peak.
They obviously didn't expect that the stunning beauty in front of them would come to find Ye Changtian.
"..."
Hearing Yue Qingshuang's words and feeling everyone's gazes, Ye Changtian froze in confusion.
He just watched the show and ate the melon, so why did he eat the melon and get it on himself?
Senior Brother Changtian?
Although he had a teacher before coming to Taixuanzong, it seemed that the teacher had never accepted such an outrageously beautiful junior sister.
"Ye Changtian, is she really your junior sister?"
Just when Ye Changtian looked confused, Song Hao's unkind eyes instantly looked towards Ye Changtian.
Ye Changtian cursed secretly in his heart.
What the hell is this?
He just came to apply for promotion to an outer disciple, why did he get into such a thing inexplicably?
Song Hao acted arrogantly and domineeringly, and he had the support of Elder Feng, the handyman behind him.
Although Yue Qingshuang is beautiful, he is not the kind of person who can't move when he sees a beautiful woman.
Offending Song Hao for an unrelated woman?
Not worth it!
Just when Ye Changtian was about to clarify, Yue Qingshuang ran towards him quickly and hugged his arm with a look of surprise.
"Senior Brother Changtian, I finally found you."
Ye Changtian's body froze instantly.
He looked at Yue Qingshuang, who was hugging his arm tightly, her face as dark as the bottom of a pot.
"Miss, I don't know you at all. What on earth do you want to do?"
Yue Qingshuang said pitifully: "Senior Brother Changtian, Song Hao clearly has bad intentions towards me, so please help me. Can you bear to see me being ruined by Song Hao like this?"
"I'm just a handyman disciple, how can I help you?"
Ye Changtian was speechless.
There are a large group of handyman disciples here, why did you come to me?
Is it because I'm the most handsome?
"Senior Brother Changtian, I don't have much at home, except for a lot of spiritual stones. As long as you are willing to help me, how about I give you a thousand spiritual stones?"
Yue Qingshuang blinked her big and smart eyes at Ye Changtian.
Before coming to Miscellaneous Peak, she had learned about Ye Changtian. This guy worked hard to earn spiritual stones every day, and he was a man who regarded wealth as his life.
Yue Qingshuang didn't talk nonsense and directly opened the way with the spirit stone.
Ye Changtian's eyes lit up slightly, and he said with a troubled expression: "Junior sister Yue, this is not a problem with the spirit stone..."
"Three thousand!"
Yue Qingshuang stretched out five slender jade fingers: "As long as Senior Brother Changtian is willing to protect me, I will give you three thousand spirit stones!"
What a little rich woman she is.
Ye Changtian's eyes suddenly shone, and he swallowed back the words that came to his lips.
He immediately said righteously: "Junior sister Qingshuang, it doesn't matter whether the spirit stone is a spiritual stone or not. What's important is that since you call me senior brother, I, Ye Changtian, have the duty to protect you!"
